scope: Core tutorial interaction validation in the pinned locomotion runtime. Nominal single-policy examples, not a robustness or hardware benchmark.
asset_credit: Microduck by Pollen Robotics; actual Newton simulation captures and recorded-data plots generated by this tutorial.

native_ui.callback_binding_check: Real ImGui context drew observations and policy panels; no simulation mocking in the separate GPU lifecycle check.
native_ui.render_boundary_regression: Public simulator reset requested inside stepping; next-widget target changed after action selection. Baseline raised KeyError(final_obs); fixed version retained applied target and recorded one viewer reset, excluding its interrupted transition.

reproduce.manual: uv run --project environments/locomotion python scripts/locomotion/playground.py --mode observations --headless --scripted --steps 60 --capture --output outputs/core-inspector-smoke
reproduce.policy: uv run --project environments/locomotion python scripts/locomotion/playground.py --mode policy --checkpoint CHECKPOINT --headless --scripted --steps 500 --output outputs/core-policy-final
reproduce.joint_plot: uv run --project environments/locomotion python scripts/locomotion/plot_playground.py --receipt outputs/core-inspector-smoke/receipt.json --output docs/locomotion/media/puppet-response.jpg
reproduce.policy_plot: uv run --project environments/locomotion python scripts/locomotion/plot_playground.py --receipt outputs/core-policy-final/receipt.json --output docs/locomotion/media/policy-driving.jpg
reproduce.supported_image: JPEG format conversion of the unmodified native playground.png pixels; quality 88.
